description: 克隆 MiniOneRec 仓库、配置多节点环境、启动 MIND 模型评估

commands.name: 删除旧的 MiniOneRec 目录
commands.description: 如果已存在则删除，确保干净克隆

commands.name: 启动模型评估
commands.description: 根据 eval_type 选择 pointwise 或 ranking 评估
commands.command: if [ "{eval_type}" = "pointwise" ]; then CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7 MIND_SIZE=small DATA_ROOT={data_root} USE_CHAT_TEMPLATE={use_chat_template} MAX_HISTORY={max_history} BATCH_SIZE={batch_size} bash scripts/eval_mind_pointwise.sh {model_path} {split}; else CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7 MIND_SIZE=small DATA_ROOT={data_root} USE_CHAT_TEMPLATE={use_chat_template} MAX_HISTORY={max_history} BATCH_SIZE={batch_size} bash scripts/eval_mind_ranking.sh {model_path} {split}; fi

commands.name: 调试模式-保持容器运行
commands.description: 保持容器运行以便进入调试，完成后可手动取消任务
commands.command: echo '=== 调试模式: 容器将保持运行，可通过 AML Portal 进入容器调试 ===' && sleep infinity
